stories.title: Trump open to Jensen Huang returning as Nvidia CEO, sees no security risk
new_facts: Huang is now ex-CEO; Trump backs reinstating him, remarking 'That's a beautiful woman' about the alleged spy.
Trump calls Huang's return 'not a bad idea' and says he had proposed Tim Cook.
Top administration members are trading blame over the scandal as Trump departs for Asia and a China stop.
Trump says Huang's affair did not put US national security at risk.
Officials have identified the woman as an intelligence asset for Beijing; Trump prepares China visit.
Tech industry campaigns for Huang's return; Trump says he 'learned a big lesson' and a 'big group' wants him back.
Trump says he is not certain the woman was actually a spy.
Huang's affair was reportedly with an executive at a Singapore-based Nvidia customer.
Huang resigned amid allegations of two affairs.
stories.line: Trump says he is open to Jensen Huang returning as Nvidia CEO and sees no national security risk.

stories.title: Trump backs Lutnick amid claims he slowed Nvidia China chip export curbs
new_facts: New story, unrelated to Brand: Trump backs Lutnick after Bessent blamed Commerce for delays blocking Nvidia AI chip exports.
New story, unrelated to Brand: Leavitt on-record account of Trump handling Cabinet clashes after the Bessent-Lutnick dispute.
New story, unrelated to Brand: Commerce targets a loophole on China data center chip use, under a rule written by Treasury and the NSC.
stories.line: Commerce Secretary Lutnick is accused of slow-walking Nvidia chip export curbs, with the Commerce Department now targeting a China data-center loophole.

stories.title: OpenAI expands free frontier-model access for academic researchers, plus AI subversion probes
new_facts: OpenAI announces a program awarding 50,000 grants giving scientists free access to its frontier models.
OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to probe model subversion, with access and disclosure restrictions.
OpenAI signed agreements with four assessors (Apollo, METR, Transluce, Goodfire) for first phase of embedded assessments.
stories.line: OpenAI is giving up to 200,000 researchers free access to its frontier AI models through an expanded grant program.

stories.title: Trump backs bringing back ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after spy scandal
new_facts: A source says Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Huang as CEO; he led the company 33 years.
A petition to bring Huang back as Nvidia CEO has gathered thousands of signatures.
Some in the Trump administration oppose Huang's return, while Silicon Valley figures push for his reinstatement.
stories.line: Trump says former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang should return, after a campaign to reinstate him over a China-linked spy honeypot scandal.

stories.title: No 10 calls Russell Brand's prison message 'appalling' and orders it investigated
new_facts: Nadine Dorries says she urged Laura Brand in 2023 to leave Russell Brand, and now says she would put it differently.
Downing Street calls Brand's prison message 'appalling' and says it is being investigated; Brand says he is 'not guilty'.
Brand compares himself to Saint Paul, says he forgives fellow sex offenders, and was convicted of one rape and three sexual assaults.
stories.line: Russell Brand's prison message, read by his wife on YouTube, is being urgently investigated by Downing Street, which called it appalling.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike hits Crimea bridge in largest attack of war
new_facts: EU sanctioned the founder of Wildberries, described as Russia's richest woman, in its latest round of sanctions over the war.
Ukraine struck the Crimea bridge in a 1,336-drone barrage, the second-highest daily figure this year, per Russia's defence ministry.
Russia reported over 2,000 Ukrainian drones in a day, its biggest attack of the war; Kyiv had a record 17 air raid alerts.
A kamikaze drone hit a Kerch bridge arch at 5.38am, temporarily halting road traffic and stranding thousands of drivers.
stories.line: Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea in a record drone attack of about 1,300 drones.

stories.title: Trump blames aging equipment for FAA ground stop, asks Congress for upgrade funds
new_facts: A nationwide FAA ground stop occurred and Trump denies responsibility for it.
Trump berated an NBC reporter over White House construction priorities, telling her 'You don't have talent'.
NBC's Yamiche Alcindor asked about D.C. construction versus crumbling aviation; Trump replied 'Losers like you'.
Trump blamed 'very old equipment that had a heart attack'; Duffy expects air travel normal Monday.
Trump was informed within 30 minutes of the Friday afternoon FAA ground stop, per U.S. officials.
Trump was absent from public view for five days before reappearing Monday.
Trump praised Transportation Secretary Duffy over the ground stop; Asia trip includes a meeting with Putin.
Ground stop affected over a million passengers; Trump blamed half-century-old equipment and flew on a Qatar-gifted jet.
Departures were grounded nationwide for more than four hours; delays lingered into Monday.
DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said no one is expected to be fired over the ground stop.
Trump's multi-day Asia swing includes summits with Putin and Xi and a possible meeting with Kim.
stories.line: A nationwide FAA air traffic ground stop halted flights; Trump blames aging equipment and asks Congress for upgrade funding.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy to be retried in March 2027 over killing of her three children
new_facts: New trial in Lindsay Clancy case set to begin March 29; case involves debate over postpartum diagnoses.
First trial ended in mistrial over criminal responsibility; judge set retrial date over prosecutors' objections.
Clancy is 36; the first trial's 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.
Judge William Sullivan set March 29, 2027 at a status hearing; prosecutors did not explicitly commit to first-degree charges.
Days before the hearing, the judge rejected Clancy's final efforts to avoid a retrial.
The killings of the three children occurred in 2023.
stories.line: A Massachusetts mother convicted in the deaths of her three children will be retried after the verdict was overturned.

stories.title: UK's Brexit reset food deal with EU draws scrutiny over trade-offs
new_facts: Prime Minister Andy Burnham is defending concessions in a new EU deal due at a Friday Brussels summit.
EU minister Hamish Falconer says the deal won't affect crisp flavours and condemns misinformation about the proposals.
Falconer says Britain would have some influence on policy under a Brexit reset food deal.
stories.line: The UK is negotiating a new EU deal that would align some post-Brexit food rules with Brussels, with trade-offs still being weighed.

stories.title: US tightens AI chip export rules to block Chinese remote access to computing power
new_facts: Administration moving forward on rules closing AI chip loophole before China trip; internal fierce debate; would curb data center business serving Chinese firms.
Interim rule requires export licenses for AI chips if firms may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.
stories.line: The Trump administration is moving to close a loophole that let Chinese firms access advanced AI chips remotely, ahead of a China trip.
